title: Reuters story quoting Flavio Estrada that the mummies are dolls

tellings.quote: In early 2024, Reuters published this about the Nazca mummies. They're not extraterrestrials, they're dolls made from animal bones from this planet joined together with modern synthetic glue, said Flavio Estrada.

plain: The Nazca mummies, three-fingered bodies from Peru that some people put forward as possibly not human, are said in a news report to be "dolls made from animal bones from this planet joined together with modern synthetic glue." Michels reads this out on his show, quoting an article from the news agency Reuters in early 2024 in which a man named Flavio Estrada gave that judgment. Michels brings it up as the main argument against the bodies being anything unearthly.
